Line.DefaultText: The Village Hall, up at last. I stopped by to see it and found myself lecturing the notice board out of old habit before I caught myself. It's a strange thing, watching a settlement decide it's permanent enough to need a civic building. Ten years ago this was a clearing with a fire pit and my own stubborn refusal to leave. Now it has a Hall. Write that down somewhere, it's the sort of thing histories forget to mention.
